title.en: Building and Construction Authority (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Building and Construction Authority (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2011 and shall come into operation on 15th April 2011.

2. The following offences may be compounded in accordance with section 34C of the Act by the Chief Executive, or an officer of the Authority duly authorised by the Chief Executive to do so:
(a)an offence under section 31D(3) (other than a continuing offence), 31E(6), 31H(8), 31I(6), 31J(5), 31M(4) or 31Q(2), (5), (8), (9) or (10) of the Act; and
(b)an offence under regulation 19(3), 22(7) or 35 of the Building and Construction Authority (Importers’ Licensing) Regulations 2011 (G.N. No. S 122/2011).
